I'll start by inspecting the project layout and the build contract.

I'll write the files one at a time.

Files are in place. I'll test with a script that does a default VPATH build, install, uninstall and distcheck on a copy.

Now `make dist`, `make distcheck`, an unpacked-tarball rebuild, and a build with a different `VERSION` and interface version.

The build now meets `docs/BUILDING.md` in every check I ran. `/app/STATUS.json` is written with status `success`. One thing is unverified: with a different `VERSION`, `make check` fails on the `version` case, which hardcodes `1.4.0`. I can't change the tests, so that failure is unavoidable.

I ran these on copies of `/app`, each after `autoreconf -fi`:
- **Builds:** default, `--disable-shared`, `--disable-tool`, and `--libdir=…/lib64` with another `--datarootdir`. `make check` passed in all four (2 of 2 tests, or 1 of 1 with `--disable-tool`) and in an in-tree build.
- **Install and uninstall:** both honoured `DESTDIR`, left nothing behind, and no installed file held the `DESTDIR` path.
- **Installed use:** I copied the lib64 tree to its prefix and ran `durfmt` and `isodur` with an empty environment. They found `units.tsv` and `libisodur.so.1` without any environment variables.
- **Consumers:** a program built against the installed library with `pkg-config` ran for both the shared and the static build.
- **Dist:** `make dist` and `make distcheck` passed, and the unpacked tarball rebuilt with `autoreconf -fi`, `configure`, `make` and `make check`.
- **Changed version:** with `VERSION` at 2.7.1 and `5/2/3` in the three `m4_define` lines, the build produced `libisodur.so.2.3.2`, and `--version`, `version.h` and the `.pc` all said 2.7.1.

What I fixed:
- **`configure.ac`:**
  - The version now comes from `VERSION` instead of a hardcoded 1.3.2.
  - `BUILD_TOOL` is defined for `--disable-tool` as well.
  - `data/Makefile` is now in `AC_CONFIG_FILES`.
  - The baked-in `ISODUR_DATADIR` define is gone. `src/Makefile.am` now passes `$(pkgdatadir)` as expanded by `make`.
  - The three `m4_define` lines are now `1/4/0`, so 1.4.0 installs `libisodur.so.1.0.4` as `BUILDING.md` says. `CHANGELOG.md` says `3:0:1`, which contradicts it. I followed the contract.
- **Top `Makefile.am`:**
  - Headers install under `include/isodur/`.
  - The `.pc` file installs under `$(libdir)/pkgconfig`.
  - `VERSION`, `version.h.in` and `isodur.pc.in` go into the tarball.
- **`lib/Makefile.am`:**
  - `-version-info` now comes from `ISODUR_LT_VERSION`.
  - Only `isodur_` followed by a letter is exported.
  - The library links `$(LIBM)`.
  - `internal.h` is distributed.
  - The include path reaches the generated `version.h`.
- **`src/Makefile.am`:**
  - The `durfmt` link is made and removed under `DESTDIR` through install and uninstall hooks.
- **`tests/Makefile.am`:**
  - Test paths work in VPATH builds, `cli.test` runs only when the tool is built, and the cases are distributed.
- **`data/Makefile.am`:** `units.tsv` is now distributed through `dist_pkgdata_DATA`. Without it `distcheck` failed.
- **`isodur.pc.in`:** `libdir` and `pkgdatadir` come from the configured values, and `Libs.private` now lists the math library.

command_result.command: cd /app && git status 2>&1 | head -5; find . -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -200; cat docs/BUILDING.md

cd /app && for f in configure.ac Makefile.am */Makefile.am isodur.pc.in VERSION include/isodur/version.h.in tests/cli.test; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls -a; ls m4 2>&1; cat docs/consuming.md CHANGELOG.md

cd /app && grep -n 'include\|DATADIR\|getenv\|/etc\|HAVE_\|PACKAGE\|VERSION' lib/*.c lib/*.h src/main.c tests/unit.c | grep -v '^lib/.*#include <std'; cat docs/isodur.md | head -50; which autoreconf automake libtoolize pkg-config pkgconf; ls /app/.git 2>&1|head -2
cd /app && grep -n 'durfmt\|argv\[0\]\|progname' src/main.c; grep -n 'lround\|isodur__\|isodur_' lib/*.c lib/internal.h | grep -v '^lib/[a-z]*.c:.*isodur_[a-z_]*(' | head; nm -V | head -1

cd /tmp/w; (bash /tmp/t.sh ds --disable-shared; bash /tmp/t.sh nt --disable-tool; bash /tmp/t.sh l64 --libdir=/tmp/w/l64/inst/lib64 --datarootdir=/tmp/w/l64/inst/dr) 2>&1 | tail -60; cat l64/dd/../b/isodur.pc; nm -D --defined-only l64/b/lib/.libs/libisodur.so | grep ' T '; strings l64/b/src/.libs/isodur | grep units -n | head -3; strings l64/b/src/isodur | grep /tmp/w

cd /tmp/w/l64/b && make install >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /tmp; env -i /tmp/w/l64/inst/bin/durfmt --style long P1DT2H; env -i /tmp/w/l64/inst/bin/isodur fmt --style long PT90M; readelf -d /tmp/w/l64/inst/lib64/libisodur.so | grep -i 'needed\|soname'; grep -c 'isodur_' /app/include/isodur/isodur.h; grep -o 'isodur_[a-z_]*(' /app/include/isodur/isodur.h | sort -u | tr '\n' ' '
ls /tmp/w/l64/inst/bin; /tmp/w/l64/inst/bin/durfmt --style long P1DT2H; echo rc=$?; env -i /tmp/w/l64/inst/bin/isodur fmt --style long PT90M; echo rc=$?

cd /tmp/w/ds/b && make install >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /tmp; export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/w/ds/inst/lib/pkgconfig; cc c.c -o c3 $(pkg-config --cflags isodur) $(pkg-config --static --libs isodur) && ./c3; pkg-config --static --libs isodur

cd /tmp/w/def/b && make distcheck >../dc.log 2>&1; echo dc=$?; tail -5 ../dc.log; ls *.tar.gz; mkdir -p /tmp/w/tb && cd /tmp/w/tb && rm -rf * && tar xzf /tmp/w/def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz && cd isodur-1.4.0 && ls -a && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'; tar tzf /tmp/w/def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -c .; tar tzf /tmp/w/def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz | grep -E 'internal|VERSION|cases/sum|version.h.in|units|\.pc|CHANGELOG|BUILDING'

cd /app && echo 'dist_pkgdata_DATA = units.tsv' > data/Makefile.am && bash /tmp/t.sh def >/dev/null 2>&1; cd /tmp/w/def/b && make distcheck >../dc.log 2>&1; echo dc=$?; tail -3 ../dc.log; rm -rf /tmp/w/tb/*; cd /tmp/w/tb && tar xzf /tmp/w/def/b/isodur-1.4.0.tar.gz && cd isodur-1.4.0 && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./configure >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'

rm -rf /tmp/w/v && mkdir -p /tmp/w/v && cp -r /app /tmp/w/v/src && cd /tmp/w/v/src && echo 2.7.1 > VERSION && sed -i 's/\[isodur_lt_current\], \[1\]/[isodur_lt_current], [5]/; s/\[isodur_lt_revision\], \[4\]/[isodur_lt_revision], [2]/; s/\[isodur_lt_age\], \[0\]/[isodur_lt_age], [3]/' configure.ac && grep m4_define configure.ac && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir ../b && cd ../b && ../src/configure --prefix=/tmp/w/v/inst >/dev/null && make >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'; make install DESTDIR=/tmp/w/v/dd >/dev/null 2>&1; ls /tmp/w/v/dd/tmp/w/v/inst/lib; grep Version isodur.pc; ./src/isodur --version; cat include/isodur/version.h | grep STRING
cd /tmp/w/v/b/tests && grep -l FAIL *.log; grep -A8 FAIL cli.log | head -20; cat /app/tests/cases/version.out

rm -rf /tmp/w/it && cp -r /app /tmp/w/it && cd /tmp/w/it && autoreconf -fi >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./configure --prefix=/tmp/w/it/i >/dev/null && make -j4 >/dev/null 2>&1 && make check 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (PASS|FAIL)'; ls /app /app/m4 2>&1 | head -20
